newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse seen extending Tuesday's slight gain.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse seen extending Tuesday's slight gain.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend Tuesday's 0.2-percent gain, signalled by the session's strong buying after price-fixing and rises in continuous trade.

But analysts said recent gains by small-cap stocks, such as those in the fundamentally less sound textiles sector, suggested that the market might soon hit a more significant correction after its recent 38-percent surge.

They also said the near-term performance of the Polish bourse could depend on those of foreign exchanges, which would be watching U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony to congress later on Wednesday.

Trade was suspended in Prochnik on Wednesday after 9.9-percent owner National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 12's Tuesday announcement of a public tender offer to up its stake to 32.9 percent by buying 343,501 shares at 11 zlotys each.
